name: Korah
title: The Rebel Against Moses and Aaron
summary: Korah was a Levite from the family of Kohath who led a rebellion against the leadership of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. He and 250 men challenged the priestly hierarchy, claiming that the entire congregation was holy. God judged him by opening the earth to swallow him and his co-conspirators, serving as a warning example for future generations.

keyEvents.title: The Rebellion Against Moses and Aaron
keyEvents.description: Korah, together with Dathan, Abiram and On, as well as 250 leaders of the congregation, rose up against Moses and Aaron, claiming that the entire congregation was holy and that Moses and Aaron had exalted themselves above the Lord's assembly.

keyEvents.title: Moses' Challenge with Incense Burners
keyEvents.description: Moses challenged Korah and his followers to come forward with incense burners before the Lord, so that God Himself could show whom He had chosen.

keyEvents.title: The Glory of the Lord Appears
keyEvents.description: The glory of the Lord appeared to the entire congregation, and God threatened to destroy the whole assembly, but Moses and Aaron interceded on their behalf.

keyEvents.title: The Earth Swallows Korah and His Followers
keyEvents.description: The earth opened up and swallowed Korah, Dathan and Abiram along with their families and all their possessions. They went down alive into Sheol as a divine sign of judgment.

keyEvents.title: The Incense Burners Become a Memorial
keyEvents.description: The incense burners of the 250 men who were consumed by fire were beaten into plates to cover the altar, serving as a warning sign for the children of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Warning in the New Testament
keyEvents.description: Jude's letter mentions Korah's rebellion as a warning example for those who rebel against God's appointed order and authority.
